FROM: H. H. Westphalen
SUBJECT: YANKELOVICH MONITOR PRESENTATION
Susan Hayward of Yankelovich Clancy Shulman will be here at 9:30 a.m. on Wednesday, October 11 to present the findings of the 1989 Yankelovich Monitor. This study, as most of you know, provides us with annual information on changing social values and their influence on consumer behavior. The meeting should last 1 1/2 to 2 hours and will be held in the Board Room.
Please let Barbara Evans (ext. 3147) know if you will be attending by Monday, October 9. Should there be a number of you who cannot be there, we'll try to schedule a repeat presentation at a later date.
H. H. W. 87530529
